name: event_detector_regime_staleness_20261109
comment: LQ-20261107-1511. The 2026-11-09 07:00 ET run fired an urgent MARKET_REGIME_CHANGE VIX_25
(agent_event_queue 7524) from a FRED VIXCLS close dated 2026-11-05, read on a Monday whose
last completed session was 2026-11-06, while live VIX was ~24.1: the lane never looked at
`observation_date`. These tests pin the refusal, the NYSE-calendar boundary (Thanksgiving
2026-11-26 is not a session), the configured lag, the strict fallback for an unusable policy,
and the LaneRunReceipt@v2 the registry's `output_signal` declares but nothing wrote.
